normative_extracts.quote: Queue a mutation observer microtask to notify each registered observer of its queued MutationRecord list.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: MutationObserver batches all synchronous DOM mutations into a MutationRecord array and invokes its callback as a single microtask before the next render.

production_failures.symptom: Tab freezes in infinite microtask loop when observing childList or attributes
production_failures.root_cause: Mutating the observed DOM subtree inside the MutationObserver callback queues another MutationRecord microtask, starving Update the Rendering.
production_failures.mitigation: Guard callbacks against self-triggered mutations or call takeRecords() / disconnect() around internal DOM writes.

production_failures.symptom: 100ms+ UI stalls when typing in a rich-text editor with subtree: true
production_failures.root_cause: Observing characterData and subtree on document.body delivers thousands of MutationRecords on every keystroke or framework render.
production_failures.mitigation: Scope observe() to the narrowest container and filter with attributeFilter instead of watching all attributes.
